vector_memory.semantic_summary: The Color class models RGBA color data using an internal gl-matrix vec4. It serves as a core data model within a graphics pipeline, providing type-safe accessors for R, G, B, and A components. Key functionalities include serialization/deserialization via JsonSerializable, conversion to vec3/vec4, and linear interpolation (lerp) between color instances.
